description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableThingFromScratchBuilder class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. It verifies various aspects of building and manipulating 'Thing' objects, including attributes, features, lifecycle, revisions, permissions, IDs, and associated constants.

classes.name: ImmutableThingFromScratchBuilderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the behavior of ImmutableThingFromScratchBuilder, covering creation, attribute management, feature handling, lifecycle, revision, modification, permissions, and ID setting functionalities.
